collection.name: fatigueModels
collection.doc: 🔁 Road fatigue load model of EN 1991-2, 4.6: FLM1 (LM1 with 0.7 Q_ik and 0.3 q_ik of its lane) or FLM3 (single vehicle of four 120 kN axles) with the axle load and distributed load the design assumes.

fields.name: model
fields.doc: 🔁 flm1 | flm3 (anything else is an invalid input).

fields.name: lane
fields.doc: 🛣️ Notional lane (1 to 3) that carries the fatigue model.

fields.name: assumed_axle_load
fields.doc: 🏋️ Axle load [N] the design assumes per axle (FLM1 tandem axle, FLM3 vehicle axle).

fields.name: assumed_udl
fields.doc: 📏 Distributed load [Pa] the design assumes on the lane (FLM1 only, not read for FLM3).
